name: Roborock Saros 10 (EU)

radios.note: Matter runs over Wi-Fi per Roborock's update notice. A manual (not cited) says 2.4 GHz only.

matter.note: Roborock's own notice lists the Saros 10 for the Matter firmware 02.32.44 (April 2025). No CSA listing was found, so check one.

apple_home.note: Via Matter; Roborock says features vary by ecosystem. Coverage says it needs iOS 18.4 or later and a home hub.

google_home.note: Via the Matter firmware update. Roborock says functions vary by ecosystem.

alexa.note: Through the Roborock Plus skill, whose support article lists the Saros 10. Matter is also available.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant has an official Roborock integration, but the page found does not name the Saros 10.

hubRequired.note: The skill links the Roborock account; no hub is mentioned.

localControl.note: Roborock does not say here whether control works without its cloud.

navigation.note: RetractSense lowers the LiDAR; structured light and an RGB camera are also listed.

selfEmptying.note: Roborock's pages seen mention hot-water mop washing in the dock but not bin emptying; EU retailers sell it with a RockDock Ultra. Not confirmed.

summary: The Roborock Saros 10 is a vacuum-and-mop robot with retractable LiDAR and 22,000 Pa suction. Roborock lists it for the Matter firmware 02.32.44, so it can be added to Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa.
caveats: Matter features vary by ecosystem, as Roborock states.
Self-emptying dock is not confirmed on Roborock's pages.
